name: tgbot-marketplace
description: Telegram Mini App and Bot for masters marketplace

scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" "npm run dev --prefix bot"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:prod --prefix backend" "npm run start --prefix frontend" "npm run start --prefix bot"
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && npx prisma migrate dev
